title: Three Mondays and One Short Stool
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：kitchen　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 kitchen 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the cook ① swept the kitchen that no tenant in the cottage would have recorded, and he said the sweeping was the whole of the Monday. The ② kitchen, meaning the stove itself and not the stool, ran three Mondays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a kitchen, he said, is the only thing in a cottage that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kitchen in that cottage had the same short stool beside it, and the ④ kitchen at the far window, meaning the jar they kept for the children to open and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A kitchen, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the cook said the recording is the part that fills three Mondays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the kitchen was the whole of the matter, meaning the warmth and not the stove. The ⑥ kitchen, meaning the warmth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; kitchen, he said, is either something you sweep or the only word that means both a stove and a warmth. He said the warmth is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ kitchen had become a line in a note, and the note had become an argument about the short stool. The ⑧ kitchen of the whole thing, the cook wrote in May, was one cottage and three Mondays of recording; kitchen, he said, is either the jar at the far window or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ kitchen I remember is the stove recorded in the note, which closed in 1971 and is still recorded as the quietest in the cottage. A ⑩ kitchen, my mother said in 1973, is the only stove that improves by being recorded; every kitchen, she said, is a warmth that has agreed to look like a stove. She said the warmth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 厨房；灶间（指小屋里每一间旁边的那一间）
B. n. 厨房；灶间（指那间厨房本身，与小凳相对）
C. 固定搭配：sweep the kitchen 打扫这间厨房
D. n. 厨房；灶间（指留给孩子们开的那只罐子那一间）
E. n. 炊事之事（抽象总称，指一处小屋的厨房之事）
F. n. 厨房；灶间（指便条里写到、被记载的的那一间）
G. n. 暖意、人情味（指一件事里人人都忙却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 人情味（抽象总称，指人人都忙却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: swept the kitchen that no tenant in the cottage would have recorded

answers.why: sweep the kitchen 意为“打扫这间厨房”，1964 年那位厨子把小屋里没有一位房客肯记载的一间厨房做了一遍。
kitchen 意为“厨房；灶间”，指那间厨房本身而不是小凳，它经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被记载。
kitchen 意为“厨房；灶间”，指小屋里每一间旁边的那一间，每一间旁边都有同一张矮矮的小凳。
kitchen 意为“厨房；灶间”，指最远那扇窗台留给孩子们开的那只罐子那一间，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
kitchen 意为“暖意、人情味”，指一件事里人人都忙却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份暖意就是那件事的全部。
kitchen 意为“人情味”，指人人都忙却无人提起的那样东西而不是那间厨房，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
kitchen 意为“厨房；灶间”，指便条里写到、被记载的的那一间，到 1969 年这一间成了便条里的一行。
kitchen 意为“炊事之事”，厨子五月写道，整件事的厨房之事是一处小屋和三个星期一的记载。
kitchen 意为“厨房；灶间”，我记得的是便条里记载过的那一间，1971 年收拾停当了，至今仍被说成小屋里最安静的一间。
kitchen 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，厨房是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的厨房。
